about: Release requirements with their legal standing and how each one is proven. See docs/RULING-REGISTER.md.

requirements.title: Personal-loan apps in India must hold an RBI licence and appear on the RBI list of digital lending apps
requirements.instrument: Google Play Financial Services policy, India personal loan requirements
requirements.authority: Google Play, Reserve Bank of India

proof_items.what: The app does not request the contacts or photos permissions in the merged release manifest
The app is listed in the RBI DLAs deployed by Regulated Entities list and the licence is shown in the Play declaration

requirements.check: Inspect the merged release manifest for contacts and photos access, then confirm the app appears on the RBI DLA list before enabling India.

sources.quote: hold and present a valid financial services license from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to offer personal loans
lending apps are prohibited from accessing sensitive user data such as contacts or photos

requirements.title: Crypto exchange and wallet apps in the EU need MiCA CASP authorisation or a documented local exemption
requirements.instrument: Google Play cryptocurrency exchange and software wallet requirements, MiCA

proof_items.what: For each enabled EU country, the CASP authorisation or the accepted exemption and the completed Play Console declaration

requirements.check: For every enabled EU country record the service type, the legal entity, the CASP authorisation or exemption, and the Console declaration. A non-custodial wallet is assessed on its own terms, never by inheriting an exchange's answer.

sources.quote: the developer must be authorized as a crypto-asset service provider (CASP) under the markets in crypto-assets (MiCA) regulation

open_questions: Whether a given exemption is accepted depends on the country and needs local advice.

requirements.title: Health software that diagnoses or treats may be a regulated medical device in the US
requirements.instrument: FDA device software functions including mobile medical applications

proof_items.what: A written classification for each medical function and advertised indication, with the authorisation, exemption or enforcement-discretion basis

requirements.check: List every medical function and claim, record its classification and the pathway that covers it, and keep the US listing off until each one is resolved.

sources.quote: Software functions span a wide range of health functions, and some require FDA review.

requirements.title: Generative AI services with public-opinion reach in China need a security assessment and algorithm filing
requirements.instrument: Interim Measures for the Management of Generative AI Services, Article 17

proof_items.what: The filing applicability decision for each model and service role, with the filing or assessment record

requirements.check: Decide whether the service has public-opinion or social-mobilisation reach, and if so keep the security assessment and the algorithm filing on record.

sources.quote: 提供具有舆论属性或者社会动员能力的生成式人工智能服务的，应当按照国家有关规定开展安全评估

open_questions: Whether an app that only wraps a third-party model API needs its own filing needs local confirmation.

requirements.title: App stores in China verify the AI-content labelling materials of apps offering generated content
requirements.instrument: Measures for Labeling AI-Generated Synthetic Content, Article 7

proof_items.what: Generated output carries a visible label and the metadata label survives download and sharing
The labelling materials the distribution platform asks for at listing

requirements.check: Test visible labels and embedded metadata through generate, download and share, and keep the labelling materials ready for the store review.

sources.quote: 互联网应用程序服务提供者提供人工智能生成合成服务的，互联网应用程序分发平台应当核验其生成合成内容标识相关材料

requirements.title: Transfers of bulk US sensitive personal data to countries of concern are prohibited or restricted
requirements.instrument: DOJ Data Security Program, 28 CFR Part 202, Executive Order 14117
requirements.authority: US Department of Justice, National Security Division

proof_items.what: A map of every SDK, analytics, cloud and support-access recipient to its ownership, the data categories and volumes, and the transaction type

requirements.check: Map each data recipient to ownership and control, data category and volume, then block prohibited transactions and document the security controls for restricted ones. OFAC screening does not answer this question.

sources.quote: The Data Security Program went into effect on April 8, 2025.

requirements.title: Private electronic system operators serving Indonesia must register or face blocking
requirements.instrument: Ministerial Regulation 5 of 2020 on Private Electronic System Operators

proof_items.what: The PSE applicability decision and, where it applies, the current registration record

requirements.check: Before enabling Indonesia, decide whether PSE registration applies and keep the registration current. Passing store review does not satisfy it.

sources.quote: Komdigi Putus Akses Tiga PSE Lingkup Privat yang Tidak Memenuhi Kewajiban Pendaftaran

requirements.title: Online distance contracts in the EU need a withdrawal function

proof_items.what: A labelled withdrawal function is reachable in the app for the whole withdrawal period
The national implementation, the contracting trader and the exceptions for each country you sell in

requirements.check: Walk the withdrawal flow to its durable confirmation, and keep it separate from cancelling a renewal.

sources.unverified: EUR-Lex refused automated fetches on 2026-11-05, so the Article 11a text and the 19 June 2026 date were not re-read today. Confirm on EUR-Lex before relying on it.

requirements.title: Apps that host user content in the EU must run a notice and action mechanism
requirements.instrument: Digital Services Act, notice and action

proof_items.what: A report-illegal-content entry point exists in the app
A notice is acknowledged, decided and answered with reasons, and the size-based exemptions you rely on are written down

requirements.check: Send a test illegal-content notice through acknowledgement, decision and the reasons sent to the user.

sources.quote: The notice and action mechanism under the Digital Services Act (DSA) is a tool provided by platforms to report illegal content

requirements.title: Social platforms in Vietnam must authenticate accounts before posting, and under-16 accounts are registered by a parent

proof_items.what: An unauthenticated account cannot post or share
The phone or identity route and the guardian sign-up for under-16s, and whether your social features are in scope

requirements.check: Prove an unauthenticated account cannot publish, and walk the guardian sign-up for an under-16 user.

sources.quote: For children aged below 16 using social media platforms, their parents or supervisors shall use their personal information to register for accounts

requirements.title: Manufacturers must report actively exploited vulnerabilities within 24 and 72 hours

proof_items.what: A named reporting owner, access to the Single Reporting Platform, and a timed drill through the early warning and the full notification

requirements.check: Name the on-call reporting owner and run a timed drill: early warning inside 24 hours, notification inside 72 hours, final report inside 14 days of the fix.

sources.quote: They need to submit an early warning within 24 hours of becoming aware, and a full notification within 72 hours.
As of 11 September 2026, manufacturers are required to report actively exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents

open_questions: Non-commercial open-source activity and open-source stewards have different duties.

requirements.title: Organisations covered by the Australian Privacy Act need a clear, current privacy policy
requirements.authority: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner

proof_items.what: A privacy policy is linked from the app and the store listing
The policy says what is collected, why, and how to access, correct or complain

requirements.check: Link the policy in the app and listing, and confirm it covers collection, purpose, access, correction and complaints.

sources.quote: An APP entity must have a clearly expressed and up-to-date APP Privacy Policy about how it manages personal information.

requirements.title: Age-restricted social media platforms must stop under-16s in Australia holding accounts
requirements.instrument: Online Safety Amendment (Social Media Minimum Age) Act 2024, section 63D

proof_items.what: Sign-up runs an age-assurance step that is more than self-declaration
Whether the platform is age-restricted, the age-assurance methods chosen, and how age data is destroyed

requirements.check: Decide whether the app is an age-restricted platform, then show the age-assurance waterfall and the data destruction.

sources.quote: must take reasonable steps to prevent age-restricted users having accounts

sources.unverified: The Act sets the start date by ministerial instrument. The 10 December 2025 date comes from eSafety guidance, which did not load on 2026-11-05.

requirements.title: Australia's Children's Online Privacy Code is due by 10 December 2026
requirements.instrument: Children's Online Privacy Code under the Privacy and Other Legislation Amendment Act 2024
requirements.authority: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner

proof_items.what: A review of the registered code text against the app once it is published

requirements.check: Watch for the registered code text and review the app against it once it is published.

sources.quote: the Code will be in place by 10 December 2026
